name: progress
description: A named progress bar. The maximum is positive and finite. A known value is finite, at least zero and at most the maximum. Omit the value when progress is unknown.

parts.name: bar
parts.description: Progress bar with a name and range.

parts.name: details
parts.description: Control and technical details of a refusal.

parts.name: indicator
parts.description: Visible mark for progress with an unknown value.

parts.name: label
parts.description: Visible name of the progress bar.

parts.name: value
parts.description: Text that shows the value and maximum or the unknown state.
